nesnd_japan.1.d.zh: 南京使节带来了新的分封方案：京都与大阪奉天皇名位，由摄政主持政务；德川以江户为府，丰臣退守关西，九州和四国则归吴朝直辖。丰臣借唐土之力建立的霸业，如今面临唐土朝廷提出的分割。家臣已呈上各地兵力与军粮，等候[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]决定如何答复。
nesnd_japan.1.d.en: Envoys from Nanjing have brought new terms. Kyoto and Osaka would recognize the Emperor, with a regent conducting the government; the Tokugawa would rule from Edo, the Toyotomi would retain a reduced western domain, and Wu would administer Kyushu and Shikoku directly. The mainland court whose armies helped establish Toyotomi power now proposes to divide it. Retainers have reported the strength and supplies of the garrisons to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName], who must decide how to answer.
nesnd_japan.1.d.reason: 天皇亲政与林摄政冲突；删去分封册的道具式收束，保留谈判局势与现有ruler引用。
nesnd_japan.1.d.mechanic: Partition proposal, not completed partition. Existing ROOT ruler token retained.

nesnd_japan.3.d.zh: 日本的分封已经施行。丰臣保有关西余部与中国地区，德川接掌江户及北方领地；京都与大阪奉天皇名位，由摄政主持和国政务。九州、四国归吴朝直辖。各政权接管辖地的税赋与军队，原由丰臣统一调度的兵力和财源从此分属数家。
nesnd_japan.3.d.en: The settlement in Japan is in force. The Toyotomi retain Chugoku and the remainder of Kansai; the Tokugawa take Edo and the northern domains. Kyoto and Osaka recognize the Emperor, with a regent conducting Wa’s government. Wu administers Kyushu and Shikoku directly. The new governments take charge of local revenues and armies, dividing the resources once commanded by the Toyotomi.
nesnd_japan.3.d.reason: 天皇亲理政务与已确认摄政制度冲突；各府为日本军政政权用语合法，无需全局改省。
nesnd_japan.3.d.mechanic: Only valid with new C partition/regency behavior.

nesnd_japan.5.d.zh: 本州各地终于归于同一个独立政府。[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]开始接管旧诸侯的赋税与军队，使彼此分立的领地遵行共同的法令。城下町的商人也在等待关卡和赋役的重新议定，准备把生意做到旧日领界之外。
nesnd_japan.5.d.en: Honshu now answers to one independent government. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is bringing the revenues and armies of the former domains under common authority. Merchants in the castle towns await a settlement of tolls and taxes as they prepare to trade beyond the old domain boundaries.
nesnd_japan.5.d.reason: 新C日志只需本州七地区；旧事件断言九州四国已统一。E仍九地区要求，禁止把该改稿提前套入E。
nesnd_japan.5.d.mechanic: Seven Honshu regions + independence; no Kyushu/Shikoku ownership guarantee.

nesnd_japan_war_tt.zh: 日本若为吴朝属国，将脱离吴朝并进入[concept_diplomatic_play]。吴朝主张重组日本，日本则要求羞辱吴朝。#v 重组日本的战争目标获执行后，才会划分领土。#!
nesnd_japan_war_tt.en: If Japan is a Wu subject, it will become independent as the [concept_diplomatic_play] begins. Wu demands the reorganization of Japan; Japan demands Wu’s humiliation. #v The territorial settlement takes effect only if Wu’s war goal is enforced.#!
nesnd_japan_war_tt.reason: 真实/real是开发验证口吻；保留独立、双方战目标及领土执行条件。
nesnd_japan_war_tt.mechanic: No change to truce, relationship or war goal.

nesnd_wu_eastern_question_reason.zh: 丰臣氏借明吴之力平定战国，又与郑氏共争朝鲜。两家的旧盟维持了海东秩序，也使九州驻军与日本诸侯结下了绵延数代的利害。如今南朝大局已定，朝廷开始议论东征：将西军旧部调往海东，在丰臣之外扶植天皇与德川的政权，使三家各领其土，九州、四国则归吴朝直辖。远洋驻军与海上商路，也将随这次分封重新安排。
nesnd_wu_eastern_question_reason.en: The Toyotomi unified Japan with Ming and Wu assistance and fought beside the Zheng in Korea. Their old alliance bound the garrisons in Kyushu to the interests of Japan’s lords. With affairs in the south settled, the court is considering an expedition: send former western officers overseas and establish imperial and Tokugawa governments alongside the Toyotomi, while placing Kyushu and Shikoku under direct Wu administration. The settlement would also reshape overseas garrisons and maritime trade.
nesnd_wu_eastern_question_reason.reason: 原中文只提天皇/德川分掌，遗漏仍保留的丰臣政权；三方分封符合E/C共同效果，不宣布天皇亲政或提前写入C摄政。
nesnd_wu_eastern_question_reason.mechanic: Three Japanese governments plus direct Wu holdings; regency identity not asserted in this shared JE.

nesnd_japan.2.d.zh: 日本使者请求撤回分封方案，仍由丰臣统一主持海东政务。南京朝廷准备以东征扶植新的日本政权，把丰臣掌握的兵力与财源分到数家。军费、舰船与海外防务也须随之重新安排。如何答复这项请求，已交由[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]裁定。
nesnd_japan.2.d.en: Japan asks the court to withdraw the partition proposal and retain a unified Toyotomi government. The proposed expedition would establish new Japanese governments and divide the forces and revenues now commanded by the Toyotomi. It would also require new arrangements for military spending, shipping and overseas defence. The decision rests with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName].
nesnd_japan.2.d.reason: 原文无条件声称南京控制九州驻军，但分封允许保留外国领土且不保证吴当前控制九州；以真实提议替代无守卫持地断言。
nesnd_japan.2.d.mechanic: Fallback negotiation event; existing ROOT ruler token retained. No new direct possession asserted.

nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.zh: 田间的收成、渔人的船和往来的粮商，维持着城里的生活。粮价一涨，街市上的怨声便传到官署。政府须让运粮的人愿意进城，也让城里的人买得起饭。
nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.en: Harvests, fishing boats and grain merchants sustain life in the towns. When food prices rise, complaints from the markets soon reach the authorities. The government must keep food coming into the towns at prices their people can afford.
nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.reason: 原句把粮价危机写成官署争论传到街市，因果和行动主体含混。
nesnd_jp_food_supply_reason.mechanic: Food supply allows farming OR affordable grain; no invented self-sufficiency requirement.

nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.zh: 城镇需要能够储存和远运的食品，粮商与渔商也在寻找收获季节以外的买主。罐藏技术让他们有机会把收购、加工和运输连成一门生意；办起食品工场，还能让雇工不必随收获季节结束而失去工作。
nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.en: The towns need food that can be stored and carried over long distances. Grain and fish merchants want customers beyond the harvest season. Canning offers a way to combine purchasing, processing and transport in one business, while food factories could provide work after the harvest is over.
nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.reason: 常驻待完成日志尚未保证已研发罐藏；由已实现事实改为待建产业及技术用途。
nesnd_jp_food_processing_reason.mechanic: Technology canneries and active cannery PM are completion requirements, not entry requirements.

nesnd_jp_development.2.d_military.zh: 主张集权的军官终于让自己的办法成为国策。征募、训练和军需被纳入统一调度，地方官员也须执行中央的命令。兵工厂与工具厂为扩充后的军队提供装备，军府由此取得了在各地贯彻政令的力量。
nesnd_jp_development.2.d_military.en: The officers have secured the centralized government they sought. Recruitment, training and supplies come under common direction, and local officials must carry out the government’s orders. Arsenals and tool workshops equip the expanded army, giving the military administration the means to enforce its policy in the provinces.
nesnd_jp_development.2.d_military.reason: 原段最后泛论军费/军官权力将长久争议，凭空补反对者与代价收束；完成条件足以陈述实际军政结果。
nesnd_jp_development.2.d_military.mechanic: Appointed bureaucracy; autocracy/oligarchy; army/building thresholds. Does not invent elections or force different governance law.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.zh: 使者带回了[SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]的答复。对方已经接受我们的提议，双方将依照商定的安排处理此事。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.en: Our envoy has returned from [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] with an agreement. Their government has accepted the proposal.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.reason: 原英文the agreed arrangements will govern the matter是空泛抽象收尾；保留无kind时的中性回退。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d.mechanic: Fallback only. Kind-specific variants need saved reply kind before request cleanup.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d1.zh: 宗主已同意放宽对本国的约束，原有的宗属关系升为更自主的等级。双方议定休兵五年，政府可以据此着手处理此前受制的事务。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d1.en: Our overlord has agreed to loosen its control, granting us a more autonomous status. The two governments have established a five-year truce.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d1.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d1.mechanic: Kind 1. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d2.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]已经承认本国独立。宗属关系就此解除，双方议定休兵五年；今后的内外事务，将由本国政府自行决定。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d2.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] has recognized our independence. The subject relationship is dissolved, and a five-year truce now stands between us. Our government will conduct its own domestic and foreign affairs.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d2.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d2.mechanic: Kind 2. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d3.zh: 宗主同意本国推行新政。政府可以开始筹划任官、军政与议政制度的改革，原有的宗属关系仍然保留。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d3.en: Our overlord has given its assent to domestic reform. The government may pursue changes to public appointments, military administration and representation while the subject relationship remains in force.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d3.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d3.mechanic: Kind 3. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d4.zh: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting]同意拨给建设资金。工场扩建与工匠训练有了新的助力；政府须善用这笔资助，三年内不能再获同类拨款。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d4.en: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] has provided development funds. The grant will support construction and the training of skilled workers. Further funding of this kind will be unavailable for three years.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d4.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d4.mechanic: Kind 4. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d5.zh: 对方接受了朝鲜和解方案。本国对釜山与两湖的宣称已经撤回，两地尚在本国掌握中的领土也已依约移交朝鲜。海峡两岸的关系将依新的边界继续经营。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d5.en: The Korean settlement has been accepted. Our claims to Busan and Yangho have been withdrawn, and any territory we still held there has passed to Korea. Future relations across the strait will proceed within these borders.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d5.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d5.mechanic: Kind 5. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d7.zh: 宗主允许本国与其他日本属国商议合邦。使者可以带着这份许可前去交涉，受邀国家仍须自行同意归并。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d7.en: Our overlord has authorized negotiations for union with the other Japanese subjects. Our envoys may now approach them, though each invited government must still consent to the union.
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d7.reason: 按已发生的结算陈述实际结果，代替所有成功外交共用空泛答复。
nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d7.mechanic: Kind 7. Save kind as event scope value BEFORE nesnd_jp_clear_request; no reply for kind6 annex.

nesnd_qe1_ruler_delta.reason: 秦王是固定王号，与本系统陈秦皇帝和可变国体不一致；本项仅君主路线贡献非零。
nesnd_qe1_ruler_delta.mechanic: nesnd_qe1_assign_ruler clears the two preference variables outside monarchy; neutral label avoids false rank.

nesnd_qe1.1.d.zh: 安国派的主张成为朝廷施政的方向。支持改制的士人与工商业者声望日隆，军府及其市民拥护者则失去了原有的政治优势。恢复生产与改造旧法，将成为新政府争取人心的凭借。
nesnd_qe1.1.d.en: The reformers have set the government’s course. Scholars and industrialists who supported reform have gained political influence, while the army and its supporters among the urban middle classes have lost ground. The new government looks to economic recovery and legal reform to win public support.
nesnd_qe1.1.d.reason: 原文“军士与武勋门阀”把实际受损小市民误写成勋贵地主；按armed_forces+petty_bourgeoisie降低、intelligentsia+industrialists增加修正行动者。
nesnd_qe1.1.d.mechanic: Only IG strength/attraction modifiers and SoL-loyalty observation, no forced office/law change.

nesnd_qe1_economy_push_button_desc.zh: 朝廷力推安国之策，要求军府与乡民团体让步，使恢复生产与改造旧法的主张占据朝议。
nesnd_qe1_economy_push_button_desc.en: Press the reform agenda at court, demanding concessions from the military and rural associations so that economic recovery and legal reform take priority.
nesnd_qe1_economy_push_button_desc.reason: 原文削减乡村旧规没交代实际承担者；效果降低军队、乡村民众赞同而非地主，且并不直接删除军队/更改法律。
nesnd_qe1_economy_push_button_desc.mechanic: Balance -25; armed forces and rural folk approval -2 for six months. Existing policy/button name retained.

nesnd_qe1.2.d.zh: 统治派取得了朝廷的支持，军府将掌握更多征募、军需与任官事务。此前要求恢复生产、改造旧法的官员未能主导新政府，伊犁已把扩充军队列为国策。
nesnd_qe1.2.d.en: The military faction has won the government’s support and will take a greater part in recruitment, supply and appointments. Officials who argued for economic recovery and legal reform have failed to set its course. Ili has made expansion of the army a priority.
nesnd_qe1.2.d.reason: 删除“代价由被排除者承担”的无对象总结；将抽象代价改成议程争夺的实际结果。
nesnd_qe1.2.d.mechanic: Military winner flag + ten-year modifier; no claim that laws/appointments are forcibly replaced.

nesnd_qe1.3.d.zh: 朝议延续了十年，田地、军饷与官职的争论仍没有结果。地方听过太多振兴帝国的许诺，越来越少的人相信下一道法令能改变自己的处境。
nesnd_qe1.3.d.en: For ten years the court has argued over land, military pay and appointments without reaching a settlement. The provinces have heard promise after promise of imperial renewal. Fewer now believe that another decree will improve their lot.
nesnd_qe1.3.d.reason: 朝议终局不限定君主制，用法令代替仅君主可发的诏令；保留十年真实计时。
nesnd_qe1.3.d.mechanic: Ten-year unresolved agenda; does not require monarch to remain in office.

nesnd_qe1_court_journal_reason.zh: 皇族以旧日征服的威望维系奉宸官僚，地方士人依靠学堂、商号和官署经营政务，军队则掌握帝国赖以扩张的武力。三方都要借助另外两方治理各地，也都在争取任官、征税和调兵的决定权。
nesnd_qe1_court_journal_reason.en: The imperial house draws on the prestige of past conquests and the loyalty of officials who owe it their position. Provincial literati work through schools, trading houses and public offices; the army commands the force on which imperial expansion depends. Each faction needs the others to govern, yet each seeks authority over appointments, revenue and military command.
nesnd_qe1_court_journal_reason.reason: 三权日志在总统共和+比例代表制下仍有效，原文现在时“皇帝任命”不一定成立；保留皇族政治力量但不虚构在位皇帝。
nesnd_qe1_court_journal_reason.mechanic: Court eligibility excludes universal suffrage/council republic, not presidential republic.

nesnd_qe1_unity_journal_reason.zh: 商路、村社与军屯曾将许多不同来历的人联结在陈秦皇帝的治下。西域汉羌既是帝国扩张的产物，也为这个国家提供了兵员与税源。人们在繁荣中接受共同的身份，也会在征役与贫困中重新寻找旧日的族名、信仰和乡里。
nesnd_qe1_unity_journal_reason.en: Trade routes, village communities and military colonies brought peoples of many origins under the Chen emperors of Qin. The Western Regions Han-Qiang emerged from that expansion and now provide much of the country’s manpower and revenue. Prosperity encourages a common identity. Conscription and hardship can lead people back to older loyalties of kinship, faith and homeland.
nesnd_qe1_unity_journal_reason.reason: 常驻团结日志在共和后仍存在；陈秦皇帝统治作为历史保留，不写成无条件现在时。
nesnd_qe1_unity_journal_reason.mechanic: Historical identity remains relevant under every current Qin government.

nesnd_qe1_patron_crown_button_desc.zh: 让拥护皇室的军士与官员掌握更多职位。
nesnd_qe1_patron_crown_button_desc.en: Give more offices to soldiers and administrators loyal to the imperial house.
nesnd_qe1_patron_crown_button_desc.reason: 共和分支仍可奖掖皇族势力，不能以现有皇室任命为职位前提。
nesnd_qe1_patron_crown_button_desc.mechanic: Patronage modifier; does not require an actual reigning emperor.

nesnd_qe1_coup_literati_button_desc.zh: 改立总统共和，由民选总统与实行比例代表的议会主持国政。
nesnd_qe1_coup_literati_button_desc.en: Establish a presidential republic with an elected president and a parliament chosen by proportional representation.
nesnd_qe1_coup_literati_button_desc.reason: 可从法团国家等非君主国体执行，原文无条件“废除皇位”不适用所有入口。
nesnd_qe1_coup_literati_button_desc.mechanic: Activates presidential republic and custom voting law; no assumption of existing throne.

nesnd_qe1_coup_crown_button_desc.zh: 以君主制与技术官僚重组政府，使皇室重新掌握国家的统治。
nesnd_qe1_coup_crown_button_desc.en: Reorganize the government as a monarchy administered by trained technocrats, restoring the imperial house to power.
nesnd_qe1_coup_crown_button_desc.reason: 按钮可从共和国恢复君主，原文“保留皇位”并非所有分支成立。
nesnd_qe1_coup_crown_button_desc.mechanic: Activates law_monarchy + law_technocracy; not gated to an existing monarchy.

law_nesnd_qe1_proportional_representatio.zh: 财产达到门槛的选民取得投票资格，识字程度也影响其选票的政治分量。各政治团体依支持力量组成议会与政府。
law_nesnd_qe1_proportional_representatio.en: Property determines eligibility to vote, while literacy increases a voter’s political influence. Political groups form parliament and government according to their support.
law_nesnd_qe1_proportional_representatio.reason: 原文将识字写成独立资格门槛；实际law是wealth threshold10 + voting_power_from_literacy50，文意需区分资格与票权。
law_nesnd_qe1_proportional_representatio.mechanic: Retains custom proportional-representation name; does not claim actual district seat-allocation simulation.

nesnd_per_claim_levant_button_desc.zh: 向有关国家递交领土照会，申明我方对当地的主张。与该地区有利害关系的强国可能出面阻挠。
nesnd_per_claim_levant_button_desc.en: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.
nesnd_per_claim_levant_button_desc.reason: 地区不能接受照会，外交行动者是有关国家；英文现稿已正确。
nesnd_per_claim_levant_button_desc.mechanic: A selected unclaimed foreign-owned state; adds claim only without obstruction.

nesnd_per_claim_egypt_button_desc.zh: 向有关国家递交领土照会，申明我方对当地的主张。与该地区有利害关系的强国可能出面阻挠。
nesnd_per_claim_egypt_button_desc.en: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.
